# NovaMind V4 — Executive Delivery Summary

**Delivered**: V3-derived codebase; plan-first checkpointed UX; typed constraint policy; expanded rule-based claim screen; local reviewer evidence ledger; reviewer feedback memory; telemetry; local deterministic next-action controller; CLI/UI; 21 extra tests; updated PM and technical documentation; source documentation.

**Actual verification**: 53 deterministic tests passed, 0 failed, JUnit evidence is regenerated by `python evals/run_offline_evals.py` and GitHub CI. No online model evaluation, CRM calls, production deployment or actual marketing conversions; all sample marketing events are synthetic.

**Why it matters for AI Agent PM**: distinguishes where model autonomy adds value from where deterministic policy must retain control; makes tradeoffs explicit; separates hypothesis, source data, reviewer attestation and verified outcome; defines measurable future evaluation instead of inventing ROI.

**Remaining gaps**: real Agent Observe–Decide–Act loop and checkpoint/recovery, fully independent claim validation, complete cost/active-time instrumentation, hosted authentication/consent, user/competitor studies and live CRM sandbox proof.
